notes.note:
[DisableDeveloperTools][1] can now disable remote automation (WebDriver BiDi and Marionette) without a restart.

  [1]: https://firefox-admin-docs.mozilla.org/reference/policies/disabledevelopertools/

Removing the [Cookies][1] policy without a restart now fully clears its site lists.

  [1]: https://firefox-admin-docs.mozilla.org/reference/policies/cookies/
Content-process crash pings are authenticated to the admin console.
The crash reporter now uses a distinct Glean app ID.
Profile management is disabled, and `browser.profiles.enabled` is locked off.
The primary password controls are disabled, because profile encryption replaces them.
Nimbus studies and rollouts, Firefox Labs, Normandy, and CFR recommendations are disabled.
"More from Mozilla", the `about:welcome` onboarding, and address bar interventions are disabled.
`datareporting.healthreport.uploadEnabled` is locked on, so users can no longer stop security events from being sent.

Users now always get a full warning period to save their work before the browser restarts when the Admin Console sets a restart deadline. Before, a browser that had been open for a long time, or had just woken from sleep, could restart immediately.
`about:support` now shows more clearly when Content Analysis uses the built-in DLP agent.

[WebsiteFilter][1] blocks that occur on a redirect now record the `BlocklistDomainBrowsed` event.

  [1]: https://firefox-admin-docs.mozilla.org/reference/policies/websitefilter/
After downgrading to an older version, the login window no longer gets stuck on an "older version" profile warning.

system_requirements:
**Prerequisites:** To use the Firefox Enterprise browser, your organization must first deploy the Admin Console on its own infrastructure. [Request early access][1] to get started.

## Windows

### Operating Systems (64-bit)
 - Windows 10 or later

### Recommended Hardware
-  1 gigahertz (GHz) or faster compatible processor or System on a Chip (SoC)
-  2GB of RAM
-  500MB of hard drive space

---

## Mac

### Operating Systems
- macOS 10.15 or later 

### Recommended Hardware
- Macintosh computer with an Intel x86 or Apple silicon processor
- 512 MB of RAM
- 200 MB hard drive space

---

## GNU/Linux

### Software Requirements

*Please note that GNU/Linux distributors may provide packages for your distribution which have different requirements.*

- Firefox will not run at all without the following libraries or packages:
    - glibc 2.17 or higher (glibc 2.28 or higher on arm64)
    - GTK+ 3.14 or higher
    - libglib 2.42 or higher
    - libstdc++ 4.8.1 or higher (libstdc++ 6.0 or higher on arm64)
    - X.Org 1.0 or higher (1.7 or higher is recommended)
- For optimal functionality, we recommend the following libraries or packages:
    - DBus 1.0 or higher
    - NetworkManager 0.7 or higher
    - PulseAudio

  [1]: https://www.firefox.com/enterprise/contact/
